data.name: Mouzam
data.gender_notes: Mouzam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mouzam means one who records or remembers. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'w-z-m', meaning to remember or to record. In Islamic history, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is described as the 'Mouzam' of Allah, as He records and remembers every action and thought of His believers. The name Mouzam carries the meaning “One who records, remembers” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mouzam usually hope their child will grow to embody one who records, remembers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying remembrance of Allah
data.etymology: Mouzam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who records, remembers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mouzam total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

As mentioned in the Quran, "Verily, Allah is the All-Knowing, the All-Aware" (Al-An'am:54). The name 'Mouzam' signifies this divine omniscience, and serves as a source of comfort and reassurance for believers. By recognizing Allah's all-encompassing knowledge, one can attain a deeper sense of submission and trust. Furthermore, being a 'Mouzam' in one's daily actions and thought allows for a greater connection to the Divine, as the act of remembrance and recording fosters a continuous awareness of Allah's presence.
